name: Preston Park Village
summary: Preston Park Village is an upscale 256,407 square foot shopping center in Plano featuring premium national retailers like HomeGoods, Ann Taylor, and Kohler alongside diverse dining and beauty services. Currently undergoing a $35 million redevelopment, the center serves one of Dallas-Fort Worth's most affluent markets with household incomes exceeding $153,000.
demographics: Preston Park Village serves an affluent and highly educated trade area with average household incomes exceeding $153,000 within a 3-mile radius, where 62% of residents hold college degrees. The center attracts a dense population of over 127,000 residents within 3 miles, complemented by a substantial daytime population of 185,000+ professionals working in the surrounding area. The primary shopper demographic consists of upper-middle-class families and working professionals aged 30-55 who seek convenient access to upscale fashion, home goods, and dining options. The trade area's strong purchasing power and education levels support the center's mix of premium national retailers and specialty services, with shopping patterns reflecting preferences for quality brands and experiential retail.
description: Preston Park Village is a vibrant 256,407 square foot shopping center located at the heart of Plano's affluent Preston Road corridor, serving one of the Dallas-Fort Worth area's most desirable retail markets. Currently undergoing a $35 million redevelopment scheduled for completion in 2026, this dynamic center combines upscale fashion retailers like Ann Taylor, Chico's, White House Black Market, and Talbots with popular home goods destinations including HomeGoods and Kohler Signature Stores. The center benefits from exceptional visibility with over 45,000 vehicles passing daily on Preston Road and 39,000 on West Park Boulevard, positioning it as a premier shopping destination within a larger 270,000 square foot retail community. Beyond traditional retail, Preston Park Village offers an impressive array of beauty and wellness services including European Wax Center, Massage Envy, and multiple salon concepts, alongside diverse dining options ranging from Panera Bread and Snooze Eatery to Tiger Cave Korean BBQ and Katy Trail Ice House. The center's strategic location within an affluent trade area boasting average household incomes of $153,000+ and a highly educated population makes it a cornerstone of upscale suburban shopping in Collin County.
